annotations.title: Pre-Sign Calldata Simulator & Stateful Blockchain Transaction Tracker

description: Simulates raw EVM hex calldata (0x...), estimates gas/fees for pre-sign payload assembly, and tracks on-chain transaction execution state, confirmations, and receipts. Use when auditing calldata before signing or tracking execution state and confirmations after broadcast; for inspecting off-chain EIP-712 typed-data signatures, use decode_eip712_permit_signature instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'action' ('network' defaults to 'base_mainnet'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (20 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

action.description: Operation: 'simulate_calldata' to simulate/decode, 'prepare_transaction' to assemble payload, or 'track_tx_state'.

calldata_hex.description: Hexadecimal EVM transaction data string starting with '0x' (e.g. '0x095ea7b3000000000000000000000000...').

network.description: Target EVM network for simulation context; defaults to 'base_mainnet' when omitted.

tx_hash.description: Transaction hash (0x...) to track on-chain execution state and confirmation depth.

name: simulate_evm_transaction_calldata

decoded_method.description: Human-readable ABI function signature matched to the selector.

prepared_payload.description: Unsigned transaction payload with estimated gas and nonce ready for wallet signing.

tx_state.description: On-chain transaction execution state, block height, and confirmation count.
